locator.text: Display 149.7, p. 149, in the proof of Proposition B.3

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The quartic polynomial is identical term by term (1 - t + t²/4 - t³/36 + t⁴/576, AxisProfile.quarticUpper), and both inequalities of the display are proved for the exact convergent series, not only formally. The rewriting is the paper's own substitution t = z/2: the Lean carries t as the variable throughout, so f₀(z) is bessel 1 t and the combination f₀(z) + z f₀'(z) is bessel 1 t + t·(d/dt) bessel 1 t, which bessel_one_add_mul_deriv identifies with bessel 0 t = ∑ (-t)^n/(n!)². The hypothesis differs slightly in the harmless direction: the paper has 1.98 < t = 2χ ≤ 2, the Lean assumes only 99/50 ≤ t ≤ 2, so the Lean statement covers the paper's range and the endpoint t = 1.98 as well. The paper's accompanying remark that the value at t = 1.98 is -75535511/400000000 is not stated as such; the Lean proves the strict bound by an explicit nlinarith certificate instead.
